Olivia: Quick heads-up — plan for the activation at SignalReally soon. Need final staff schedule, demo rotations, and lead routing by EOD Thursday.
Marco: On it. Can we lock demo rotations first? We only have two pod stations.
Priya: +1 lock rotations. Also need the follow-up email copy for webinar invites and post-event nurture.
Jules: Working on updated one-pager and a small 2-up postcard for the table. Will share mock in ~2 hrs.
Sam: Who's owning lead capture tech? QR -> form -> Salesforce or badge scan?
Olivia: Preference is QR -> short form -> HubSpot list. Sam you own mapping to sales queue.
Marco: Logistics note — swag shipment ETA Thu 5pm to the venue. ETA pushed from Mon. Tracking: UPS 1Z9999... (will post full).
LogisticsBot: Reminder: venue load-in window Fri 08:00–10:30. Pallet dock reserved.
Priya: For speaker submissions: we have 3 accepted slots. Need speaker names + 2 slides each by Wed. Also decide if we do a 20-min talk or 12-min lightning. Thoughts?
Olivia: Let's do one 20-min and two 12-mins. Gives more breathing room for a small deep-dive.
Jules: Design for slide template uploaded: https://drive.redwood/designs/activation-template.png — use only brand colors, small footer with QR.
Sam: For sales routing: proposed rules — MQLs > demo interest go to SDR queue, enterprise leads flagged with company size > 250 => AE queue. Everyone else gets marketing nurture. Ok?
Priya: That mapping works. I'll update the lead scoring sheet. Can someone add an auto-tag for "conference:signalreally"?
Marco: Added tag rule to the form: conference=signalreally.
Olivia: Staffing shifts — need 2 people on demo pod A, 1 floater for walk-ups, 1 person at table for swag & talk signups per shift. Shifts: 10:00–13:00, 13:00–16:00, 16:00–19:00. Who is available for the 16:00 slot?
Sam: I can take 16:00–19:00 demo pod A.
Jules: I'll do 10:00–13:00 table.
Priya: I can do floater 13:00–16:00.
Olivia: Perfect. Need one more for 13:00–16:00 demo pod A. @Marco any ops folks?
Marco: I can cover 13:00–16:00 demo pod A if needed.
Priya: Blocks for speaker stage: we should rehearse run-through Tues 4pm in the smaller room. RSVP in the calendar invite I just sent.
Olivia: Also: contingency for WiFi drop — pre-baked short demo videos on an iPad, and downloadable PDF with steps. Jules, can you export 2-min videos?
Jules: Yep — will export two 2-mins and one 45s highlight clip. Uploading to Drive by EOD.
LogisticsBot: Shipping update: package delivered to venue at 2025-06-12 16:37 local. Signature: Venue Rep.
Sam: For post-event outreach — PR/benchmarks narrative: let's collect a few latency/cost claims from eng (small data points) and craft a short bench story for the blog + LinkedIn post. Priya, can you lead that?
Priya: Yes. I'll sync with Eng runtime on Monday and draft a 300–400 word benchmark highlight.
Olivia: One last thing — lead follow-up SLA: SDRs to claim within 24h, AE outreach within 48h for enterprise. Putting that in the playbook doc.
Marco: Copy that. I'll add contact list and emergency vendor contacts to the shared folder.
Olivia: Thanks team — if nobody objects, I'll freeze this plan at 17:00 today and send the final runbook. :thumbsup:
Sam: No objections. :rocket:
Jules: all good.
Priya: Thanks — will finish scoring sheet and follow-ups.
Olivia: Runbook note posted here: https://drive.redwood/runbooks/signalreally-activation-runbook.pdf — check for any missing bits and ping me directly.
